title: Chama bar Chasa

paragraphs: [Shabbat 88a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.88a.5) mentions Rabbi Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa. [Eruvin 55a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.55a.1) has bar Dosa. Hyman gives Rabbi Avdimi bar Chama for [Zevachim 118a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.118a.18) and reports bar Chama bar Dosa from Dikdukei Soferim. Hyman states that a dalet and vav undoubtedly became a chet, or the reverse.[^2]

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat 88a reads Rav Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa. Hyman prints Rabbi and expresses certainty about the letter change, without choosing its direction.

The linked Zevachim actually gives Rabbi Avdimi bar Chasa. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=103&lang=en) also notes Chasa in Shabbat and Dosa in Eruvin and treats one as an error. Hyman proposes a letter change and leaves its direction open.
